name: Open Terminal
description: Open Terminal provides remote command execution, interactive terminals, and file management through an authenticated API. Connect it to Open WebUI to use a terminal and browse files alongside your chats.

notes.text: In Open WebUI, add the container URL and OPEN_TERMINAL_API_KEY from /etc/open-terminal/open-terminal.env under Admin Settings → Integrations → Open Terminal.
Commands run as open-terminal without sudo. The API key grants access to this user’s files and network; use separate instances for users who need isolation.
